in_sanskrit.name: जगनमयी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies the universe and all its beings.

in_telugu.name: జగన్మయీ

in_marathi.name: Jaganmayi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaganmayi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaganmaya is a name of the goddess Durga, meaning 'mother of the universe'. She is revered as the mother of the cosmos, the mother of all beings and the mother of the universe.
